notes.strength_ppg: Expected points per game against an average opponent at a neutral venue. Averaging over every possible opponent removes the schedule, which real points per game cannot.
notes.rank_delta: Table position minus the model's strength rank. Positive means the club is performing below where it sits.
notes.luck: Actual points minus the points the xG deserved. Sustained over time it is usually finishing variance, not a skill.
notes.sos_delta: Mean strength of opponents still to play minus those already played. Positive means the hard part is still to come.
